paragraphs.text: Tesak is an elemental dog native to Ravnica and serves under the command of the infamous performer Judith .

Among the members of the Cult of Rakdos , Judith is one of the most celebrated performers, but she is also a frequent target of envy, sabotage, and vengeance from rivals. After suffering multiple nights of disrupted shows, Judith acquired Tesak — a fierce, ravenous hellhound elemental — to intimidate and deter those who sought to ruin her performances. Seizing the opportunity for theatrical effect, she integrated Tesak into her act, where the hellhound's wild antics quickly became a crowd favorite. What started as a single hellhound eventually grew into a small pack, though Tesak remains her preferred companion. Offstage, Tesak is often seen roaming the dance floors of Hellbender, where club patrons nervously offer it treats, hoping to keep it at bay.
